title.narrative: Clean Energy and Network Efficiency Improvement Project

description.narrative: The project includes three components: (i) transmission infrastructure; (ii) network efficiency improvements; and (iii) pilot solar rooftop power generation investments in the Eastern, North-Central, Central, Northern, Southern, and Western provinces of the country.
